user_stories.title: Update stream() function to accept context parameter
acceptance_criteria: stream() function signature includes ctx context.Context as first parameter
stream() function checks ctx.Done() before processing each line in the scanning loop
Context check uses select statement with default case to avoid blocking
Nil logs channel handling remains unchanged
Buffer pool usage remains unchanged
Backpressure and dropping logic remains unchanged
All existing tests that call stream() are updated to pass context
user_stories.notes: This is the foundation for the fix - without context awareness in stream(), the errgroup cancellation cannot propagate to the streaming goroutines. The select pattern must be: select { case <-ctx.Done(): return; default: // continue processing }

user_stories.title: Replace errgroup.Group with errgroup.WithContext
acceptance_criteria: Line 1094 changes from 'g := new(errgroup.Group)' to 'g, ctx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)'
Comment at line 1092-1093 is updated to reflect that errgroup context is now used for cancellation
The returned ctx from errgroup.WithContext shadows the parameter ctx (intentional)
Stream goroutines are updated to pass the new ctx to stream() calls
Code compiles without errors
All existing tests pass
user_stories.notes: The shadowing of ctx is intentional and correct Go practice - all goroutines should use the errgroup's context which cancels when any goroutine returns an error. This is the core fix for the race condition.

user_stories.title: Move process wait goroutine into errgroup
acceptance_criteria: waitCh pattern is removed (lines 1104-1105)
cmd.Wait() is added as a third goroutine in the errgroup via g.Go()
New errCh pattern is created to wait for g.Wait() completion
Select block updated to listen on errCh instead of waitCh
g.Wait() is called only once in a separate goroutine, not inline
Cancellation path (ctx.Done() case) handles process interrupt/kill and waits for errCh
Normal completion path (errCh case) handles process completion
Both paths call sendLine and closeLogs appropriately
Error messages preserve original wording
2-second timeout for force kill is preserved
user_stories.notes: This unifies all three goroutines (stdout, stderr, wait) under the errgroup for consistent cancellation handling. The errCh pattern is necessary because we can't call g.Wait() inline in the select block - it would block. Instead, we wait for g.Wait() in a goroutine and select on the result channel.

user_stories.title: Manual testing and verification
acceptance_criteria: Build succeeds with 'make build'
No lint errors with 'make lint-go'
TUI cancellation tested: Start a run, press 'q' to cancel, verify clean exit
API server shutdown tested: Start server, send SIGINT, verify clean shutdown
Normal completion tested: Run a simple PRD to completion without errors
Long-running cancellation tested: Start a long-running process, cancel mid-stream, verify no hang
Code review completed by another developer
Documentation updated if necessary
user_stories.notes: Manual testing is essential because the race condition is timing-dependent and may not always manifest in automated tests. TUI cancellation is the primary user-facing scenario where this bug would occur. The 2-second graceful shutdown should be observable during manual testing.
